text.p: Cabot Corp said Wednesday it is looking toward 1998 with "guarded optimism" for earnings improvement in each of its businesses after reporting lower third quarter earnings.

The company reported earnings of $0.40 a share on sales of $398.6 million, compared with earnings of $0.48 a share in the 1996 period, which included $0.03 a share in earnings from a business that was later sold.
The company said it believes its new product and new business initiatives will contribute significantly to earnings growth over the next several years.

However, it noted that this year it has reported negative year-to-year earnings comparisons for each of the first three quarters. It attributed the results to carbon black pricing in Europe and Pacific Asia, the effects of a strong U.S. dollar and new product development funding.

"Because of volume increases in our chemical businesses during the year, we have narrowed the unfavorable earnings variance in each successive quarter," the company said. "We continue to manage costs aggressively. We look to 1998 with guarded optimism for earnings improvement in each of our businesses."
